title: An extension with constant finite ends has local constant finite presentations
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], B a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and S a short exact sequence of modules over the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose S.X1|U and S.X3|U are isomorphic to constants of finite B-modules M and N [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package, def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Then U has a covering sieve whose every member V admits finite B-modules K,Q and a morphism a:constant(K)|V→constant(Q)|V with S.X2|V≅coker(a). No assertion that a itself comes from a B-linear map is included.

source.place: Tag 093U, lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant (3), an extension with constant finite ends has local constant finite presentations

proof.text: Choose a surjective B-linear map q:B^n→N from a finite free module. Its kernel K is finite over the Noetherian ring.

Constant-module exactness and exact restriction give short exact sequences for the constant presentation 0→K→B^n→N→0 on every slice. Transport the restricted extension through the chosen trivializations of its ends.

The composite constant(B^n)|U→constant(N)|U→S.X3|U lifts through the original extension epi on a covering sieve. Naturality of the trivialization verifies that its composite with the transported quotient map is the constant q.
Apply the categorical cokernel-presentation lemma on each slice. It expresses S.X2|V as the cokernel of a map from constant(K)|V to constant(M)|V⊕constant(B^n)|V.

Preservation of binary biproducts by the additive constant functor and by exact restriction identifies the target with constant(M⊕B^n)|V. Transport the cokernel across this isomorphism. The finite direct sum is finite, completing the claimed presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cover_constant_presentation [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (S : ShortComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((constantSheaf J RingCat.{u}).obj (RingCat.of B))))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (U : C) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} B)
    (hM : Module.Finite B M) (hN : Module.Finite B N)
    (eM : S.X₁.over U ≅ ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj M).over U)
    (eN : S.X₃.over U ≅ ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj N).over U) :
    ∃ T ∈ J U, ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), T f →
      ∃ K Q : ModuleCat.{u} B, Module.Finite B K ∧ Module.Finite B Q ∧
        ∃ a : ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj K).over V ⟶
          ((strictPerfectConstantSheaf J B).obj Q).over V,
          Nonempty (S.X₂.over V ≅ cokernel a)
